notes: Account summary: internal engineering-heavy org building an internal knowledge + code search platform for 3k+ devs. Primary goal: reduce mean time to code understanding and accelerate onboarding.
Scale: target corpus 30-50M embeddings (code snippets, blobs, doc pages). Frequent updates: nightly full + incremental every 4 hours; some CI-triggered re-indexing on merge events.

Performance targets: p95 retrieval < 120ms for dense recall (topK retrieval), end-to-end p95 < 250ms when applying cross-encoder reranker for top10. SLOs are strict: engineering leads said 'If we can't hit p95 < 100ms for simple queries, won't move forward', but they're willing to accept slightly higher for rerank stage.
Cost sensitivity: target cost per query $0.0008-$0.002 (including retrieval + rerank amortized). Primary ask: clear cost model for Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private, include caching/TTL impacts.

Reranking approach: prefer two-stage retrieval — embed-only ANN for candidate generation (HNSW/OPQ) then lightweight cross-encoder rerank for topN. They want an option to run reranker on GPU pool (burst) and fallback to cheaper CPU model when busy.

Indexing & storage concerns: 30-50M 1536-dim embeddings -> planning for sharding, incremental snapshotting, compaction. Wants configurable retention/TTL and ability to hot-swap embeddings models with zero-downtime rollouts.

Security & compliance: Okta SSO/SAML required + SCIM for provisioning, audit logs for all admin actions, KMS integration for envelope encryption, EU data residency for EU users, SOC2/ISO27001 are must-haves for procurement.
Deployment preference: POC ok on Hosted for speed, long-term leaning toward Dedicated or Private (VPC) due to data residency and audit needs.

Internal doc request: engineering wants an 'integration playbook' doc w/ recommended shard sizing, batching parameters, reindex window configs, and expected unit economics at 10M / 50M / 100M vectors. Asked Redwood for an internal engineering doc and sample Helm charts.
Quote from Head of Search (call): 'We need deterministic cost estimates tied to QPS and index size — surprises kill the deal.'

Tech stack notes: currently using monorepo with CI-triggered indexing jobs (Kubernetes), primary language Go + Python, storage on S3-object backed vector store. They run custom preprocessing for code tokens and keep per-repo provenance metadata.

POC acceptance criteria (requested): ingest 10M embeddings, p95 retrieval < 120ms for topK=50, rerank end-to-end p95 < 250ms, cost model with 3-month projection, successful SSO test, legal signoff on residency/retention.
